ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, E is a point on the diagonal BD of the square ABCD. Connect AE and CE, and extend CE to meet AD at point F. If $\angle AEC = 140^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DFE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a square,\\
it follows that AB = CB, and $\angle ABE = \angle CBE = \angle ADB = 45^\circ$.\\
In $\triangle ABE$ and $\triangle CBE$, we have\\
\[
\left\{
\begin{array}{l}
AB = CB\\
\angle ABE = \angle CBE\\
BE = BE
\end{array}
\right.,
\]
thus $\triangle ABE \cong \triangle CBE$,\\
which implies $\angle AEB = \angle CEB$.\\
Also, since $\angle AEC = 140^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle CEB = 70^\circ$.\\
Because $\angle DEC + \angle CEB = 180^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle DEC = 180^\circ - \angle CEB = 110^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle DFE + \angle ADB = \angle DEC$,\\
it follows that $\angle DFE = \angle DEC - \angle ADB = 110^\circ - 45^\circ = \boxed{65^\circ}.$

method.method_draft: Use an analytic angle-orientation route. Read from the diagram that the square can be placed with B=(0,0), C=(1,0), D=(1,1), A=(0,1), and E=(t,t) on diagonal BD, with line C-E-F meeting the top side AD at F. From the text, ∠AEC = 140°. Let α be the angle that line EC makes below the positive horizontal direction; this is also the desired ∠DFE because FD is horizontal to the right and FE lies on the same line as CE. Let β be the acute angle that line EA makes above the negative horizontal direction. Since E=(t,t), the slopes of EC and EA give tan α = t/(1−t) and tan β = (1−t)/t, so α + β = 90°. From the geometry of the directions at E, the smaller angle between EA and EC is 180° − (α − β) for the pictured case E past the center of BD; this equals 140°, so α − β = 40°. Solving α + β = 90° and α − β = 40° gives α = 65°. Hence ∠DFE = 65°.

推理：按照图中方位放置坐标：B=(0,0)，C=(1,0)，D=(1,1)，A=(0,1)，E=(t,t)，且由图可知 E 在中心偏 D 一侧，所以 t>1/2。设直线 EC 相对于正水平方向向下的锐角为 α，则在 F 点，FD 是正水平向右，FE 与 EC 同线并向右下，因此所求 ∠DFE=α。设 EA 相对于负水平方向向上的锐角为 β。由 E=(t,t)，C=(1,0)，A=(0,1)，可得 tan α=t/(1-t)，tan β=(1-t)/t，因此 tan α · tan β=1，且 α、β 都是锐角，所以 α+β=90°。在点 E 处，射线 EC 的方向是正水平向下转 α，射线 EA 的方向是负水平向上转 β；由于图中 t>1/2，即 α>β，∠AEC 的较小角为 180°-(α-β)。题给 ∠AEC=140°，所以 180°-(α-β)=140°，得到 α-β=40°。联立 α+β=90° 与 α-β=40°，解得 α=65°。因此 ∠DFE=65°。

raw_record.original_question: E is a point on the diagonal BD of the square ABCD. Connect AE and CE, and extend CE to meet AD at point F. If $\angle AEC = 140^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DFE$?
raw_record.answer: Since quadrilateral ABCD is a square, it follows that AB = CB, and $\angle ABE = \angle CBE = \angle ADB = 45^\circ$. In $\triangle ABE$ and $\triangle CBE$, we have $AB = CB$, $\angle ABE = \angle CBE$, and $BE = BE$, thus $\triangle ABE \cong \triangle CBE$, which implies $\angle AEB = \angle CEB$. Also, since $\angle AEC = 140^\circ$, it follows that $\angle CEB = 70^\circ$. Because $\angle DEC + \angle CEB = 180^\circ$, thus $\angle DEC = 180^\circ - \angle CEB = 110^\circ$. Since $\angle DFE + \angle ADB = \angle DEC$, it follows that $\angle DFE = \angle DEC - \angle ADB = 110^\circ - 45^\circ = \boxed{65^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, ABCD is a square, A is at the upper left, D is at the upper right, C is at the lower right, and B is at the lower left; BD is the diagonal from B to D, and point E is located on diagonal BD; line segments AE and CE have been connected, and after CE is extended upward, it intersects the upper side AD at point F. The angle DFE is required, given that ∠AEC = 140°.

Reasoning: The diagonal BD of the square is an axis of symmetry, and A and C are symmetric with respect to BD. Because E is on BD, EA = EC. Thus triangle AEC is an isosceles triangle, with vertex angle ∠AEC = 140°, and the two base angles are equal, so ∠EAC = ∠ACE = (180° - 140°) / 2 = 20°. Draw auxiliary diagonal AC. In a square, diagonal AC forms 45° with side CD, so ∠ACD = 45°. At point C, CE lies between CA and CD, therefore ∠ECD = ∠ACD - ∠ACE = 45° - 20° = 25°. Also because CD is perpendicular to AD, and F is on AD, triangle CDF is a right triangle, ∠CDF = 90°. Thus ∠DFC = 180° - 90° - 25° = 65°. Since F, E, and C are collinear, ∠DFE is the same as ∠DFC, so ∠DFE = 65°.
